newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Four stocks rose, two fell and 12 were flat in 10-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Wednesday with the WIG 20 index up 0.7 percent to 1,585.9 points.
The remaining six stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell one percent to 141 zlotys in a 2.6-million-zloty turnover.
Four National Investment Funds (NFIs) rose, one fell and eight were flat in 0.9-million-zloty trade. Two did not trade.
